question: Which mantra accompanies the performance of the great light-waving?
premises: The mantra 'na tatra sūryo bhāti' is used
This follows in the ritual sequence
inference: Reciting 'na tatra sūryo bhāti', one should likewise perform the great light-waving.
plain_english: Reciting 'na tatra sūryo bhāti', one should likewise perform the great light-waving.
